name: Night sky
summary: Ink sketch night sky background: big starry sky, moon, Milky Way band, silhouette hills and trees at the bottom.

params.name: time
params.note: night is the default; dusk gives a violet sky with stars still showing

params.name: weather
params.note: clear shows all the stars; cloudy and above cover the sky with grey cloud

params.name: silhouette
params.note: colour of the distant hills and trees

params.name: seed
params.note: varies stars, clouds and tree placement

params.name: anim
params.note: drift = clouds move, stars twinkle, trees sway and fireflies blink

author: krakujs
